about_the_game:
A Relaxing Yet Challenging Parking Game – Simple Fun, No Stress!

Ever struggled to parallel park in real life? Now you can practice (and laugh at your mistakes) in this lighthearted, minimalist parking simulator! Navigate tight spots, tricky angles, and wildly different vehicles—from tiny hatchbacks to huge buses and trailers—across 50+ levels in everyday settings like malls, streets, and garages.

FEATURES

What This Game Offers:

✅ 5-6 Hours of Playtime – Master parking in malls, streets, garages, and more!

✅ Simple but Addictive Gameplay – No complicated controls, just pure parking fun.

✅ 11 Unique Vehicles – Park a small hatchback, a long pickup truck, a mirrorless delivery van, a trailer, even a bus! Each handles differently.

✅ Multi-Camera Views – Switch between in-car (with working mirrors!) and top-down for the best angle.

✅ Score-Based Challenges – How straight is your parking? How much space did you leave? Aim for perfection!

✅ 3 Difficulty Modes – Play casually or test your skills in Hard Mode!

⚠️ Potentially Some Bugs – I am a solo-developer, but I’ll keep improving!

What This Game DOES NOT Offer:

❌ Hardcore Realism – Physics, collisions, and sounds are simplified (no ultra-realistic sim here!).

❌ Multiplayer/Open World – Focused on solo parking challenges.

❌ AAA Graphics – Proudly lighthearted & stylized!

❌ High-Speed Thrills – No drifting, no 100km/h speeds (it’s a parking lot, after all!).

❌ Traffic Systems – No AI cars or traffic lights—just you and the parking space.

Perfect for players who want:

  • A chill but engaging parking experience.

  • Lighthearted fun without hardcore simulation stress.

  • A game that doesn’t take itself too seriously!

🚀 Meet the Developer – Let’s Build This Together!

Hi there! I’m a solo indie dev (and a lifelong gamer who grew up on classics from the ’80s to 2000s!). By day, I’m also a dad to two young boys—my toughest (and cutest) beta testers! 🎮

Now, I’m creating fun, polished experiences full-time—like this parking challenge.

If you enjoy lighthearted, minimalist games made by fellow gamers, I’d be thrilled if you gave it a try—and maybe even left a review! Thanks for supporting indie devs like me. ❤️

As a one-person team, I take feedback extremely seriously. Spot a bug? Have ideas? Let me know! Got a tricky parking spot from your hometown? 📸 Send me a pic—it might become a new level!

Wishlist now and join the journey—your input truly matters!
